# Real SEAC REF-AR-DO encodings, extracted verbatim from the RESPONSE_ALL_REF_AR_DO
# literal of cheeriotb/aram-cardlet (https://github.com/cheeriotb/aram-cardlet,
# src/com/github/cheeriotb/aram/cardlet/AramApplet.java:60-1005). That blob is the
# hand-authored catalog the Android Secure Element CTS exercises: 41 rules, tag FF40
# length 0x06A8 = 1704 bytes of payload, walked here as 41 top-level E2 elements.
#
# They are used as fuzz seeds precisely because they are field-real and because they
# include shapes this applet deliberately rejects as well as shapes it accepts:
# a 6-byte all-FF wildcard AID with a PERM-AR-DO carrier-privilege mask, the
# zero-length catch-all AID-REF-DO, 16-byte CTS applet AIDs, 20-byte DeviceAppID
# certificate hashes, 1-byte Always/Never APDU-AR-DOs and 8/16-byte APDU filter+mask
# pairs.
#
# One REF-AR-DO per line, uppercase hex, no separators. Comments start with '#'.
